name: IDLIX
release_notes:
1. Enhanced Movie Detection: Android WebView onLoadResource hook reliably captures iframe HLS (.m3u8) streams and subtitles.
2. Ad & Betting Sponsor Filter: Completely blocks asia9sports.com and pre-roll ads from casting.
3. In-Player Controls: Floating Cast and Fullscreen buttons directly on the player container with TV remote support.
4. Fixed Player Fullscreen: Keeps WebView active and injects iframe fullscreen permissions.
5. Refined TV Navigation: Curated selection for movie cards, banners, navbar, and action buttons without clutter.
